items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: You remember Johnny... Johnny Dunn. Johnny Dunn, the Florence Mills show was downtown... I felt like hiding myself... He made him look bad.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Just one trumpet. Joe Oliver's over to the Royal Garden. I'll tell you something. You remember Johnny, what is trumpet player playing with Florence Mills, Johnny, you ought to know. Johnny Dunn. Johnny Dunn, the Florence Mills show was downtown, you know. And he got off and Johnny, he was sharp dressed, you know, he's standing up there with his coat on, you know, and a cane, no hat, hair shining like a onion, you know. He's looking at Louis and it was early in the evening and Ron McGaugh's out there doing…
